conclusion: Batch checks added, off by default per project (project checks --batch on|off, Settings → Projects → Checks). With Full checks, results that finish within 10 minutes share one check on a temporary detached merge commit. A pass gives each result a sealed receipt naming that commit (Checked together with … on <sha>). A failure splits the batch down to the breaking result. Conflicts are checked one by one. No real ref changes, and Merge waits for the batch check.
changes: New src/batch-policy.ts (setting, ledger-audited) and src/batch-checks.ts (queue, cohorts, merge/split/conflict runner, sealed receipts) built on the follow-up check ledger
builder.ts: with batching on, a Full build queues its exact commit instead of checking inline; its proof reads like Off (attested) until the batch receipt lands
Shared status, the assignment projection, the result Checks tab, the CLI command, the surface entry, lead facts and docs/design/task-status.md all show batching
workspace-ui.ts: a log section header is no longer offered as a silent check's failing line (regression test added)
verification: vitest: batch-checks, check-levels, task-status, task-status-surfaces, lead-capabilities, cli, builder, operate, serve.results, workspace-ui: 453 passed
Headless journey (synthetic data) at 1280 and 390 px: settings, together, failed, waiting and Checks tab, with no horizontal overflow; screenshots in evidence/batch-checks
followUps: A batched build's inline proof is attested, not verified, so automatic review (which needs a passing check) won't run for it. Decide whether review should wait for the batch receipt
A cohort closes when a second result arrives (per the plan), so most batches have 2 results; a size or time-based close would batch more
An abandoned batch claim shows as not finished and needs Run checks; it isn't re-queued automatically
Chat has no batch-toggle action; the lead's project facts point to the existing Settings path
